sloka: अतीतानि महबहो तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः ।सुप्रीतो भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रजानाम् पतिः ईश्वरः ॥१-४२-१४॥
transliteration: atītāni mahabaho tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ ।suprīto bhagavān brahmā prajānām patiḥ īśvaraḥ ॥1-42-14॥

translations.english: O mightyarmed, (Rama) Bhagiratha continued in that state for a thousand years amidst rigid austerities. Lord of all creatures, Brahma was highly pleased with that illustrious king.
